title: Tru Tien Episode 12: The Price of Undoing Pain
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: Using the curse meant she would feel every wound she closed, every grief she reversed. By noon, she had felt the death of ten thousand soldiers — in her own body.
concept.story_arc: Price revealed → Soldier after soldier → Widow's grief floods in → Body breaking → Desperate choice

shots.prompt: Wide shot at dawn — she stands in the war valley, surrounded by dozens of healed soldiers, restored widows, reunited families. They kneel before her, weeping with gratitude. But she is not celebrating. She collapses to her knees — blood pouring from her nose, her ears, her eyes. Every wound she healed is now in HER body. Camera: wide, grateful healed crowd kneeling, her collapsing in blood at center, dawn light. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide — grateful healed crowd kneeling, her collapsing in blood at center, dawn valley, 6s
shots.narration: By dawn, she had healed thirty soldiers. And in her body she bore thirty wounds. Each one screamed.
shots.sfx: Crowd weeping, her blood dripping, dawn wind, ominous choral swell

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up — her POV: vision blurring. She feels a soldier's gut wound — her own stomach tears. She feels a widow's grief — her own heart shatters. Multiple sensations layered. She claws at the ground, screaming. The grimoire beside her GLOWS. Camera: extreme close-up, her POV distortion, layered pain, ground clawing, glowing grimoire. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — her POV distortion, layered pain from multiple soldiers, clawing ground, glowing grimoire beside her, 6s
shots.narration: She felt a soldier's spear through his chest — her own ribs cracking inward. She felt a widow's three-year grief — her own heart dissolving. And there were ten thousand more wounds to feel.
shots.sfx: Gut wound tearing sound, heart shattering sound, her scream layered, grimoire pulsing, horror strings

shots.prompt: Medium shot — a healed soldier approaches her. He kneels. 'What is your price, witch?' She looks up, face covered in blood, and says: 'Every wound you survived — I am surviving it NOW. In your place. So that you don't have to.' He stares. She collapses again. Camera: medium two-shot, soldier's shocked kneel, her bloody explanation, her collapse, blood pooling. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Two-shot — healed soldier's shocked kneel, her bloody explanation, her collapse, blood pooling, 6s
shots.narration: Every wound you survived — I am surviving it now. In your place. So that you don't have to carry it anymore.
shots.sfx: Her collapse thud, soldier's sharp breath, blood pooling spreading, emotional orchestral swell

shots.prompt: Close-up — she lies on the ground, barely conscious. Blood everywhere. But her hand — her hand still reaches toward the grimoire. She will NOT stop. She opens it again. The curse adds MORE names. She accepts another wave of pain. Tears and blood mix on her face. Camera: close-up, bloody ground, her conscious hand reaching to grimoire, more names appearing. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — her bloody face on ground, hand reaching to grimoire, curse adding more names, tear and blood mix, 6s
shots.narration: She could have stopped. The curse would have waited. But for every name in that book, there was a person who deserved to live without pain. And she would carry it for them.
shots.sfx: Her weak hand dragging, page turning, her sob, blood spreading, determined strings

shots.prompt: Wide cinematic at sunset — she stands on a hill, barely upright. She is ALIVE. Blood-stained, shaking, but alive. Below her: a valley of healed survivors. They look up at her with fear and awe. She looks at the grimoire — pages still filling. The curse is not done with her. Camera: wide cinematic, blood-stained woman on hill at sunset, healed valley below, grimoire still filling, survival stance. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide cinematic — blood-stained woman standing on hill at sunset, healed valley below, grimoire still filling, survival stance, 6s
shots.narration: She had survived ten thousand wounds in one day. And the curse was still writing. Still adding names. And she had made her choice: she would carry them all.
shots.sfx: Wind, distant survivor murmur, her exhausted breath, sunset orchestral, dark determination

audio.narration: By dawn, she had healed thirty soldiers. And in her body she bore thirty wounds. Each one screamed. She felt a soldier's spear through his chest — her own ribs cracking inward. She felt a widow's three-year grief — her own heart dissolving. And there were ten thousand more wounds to feel. Every wound you survived — I am surviving it now. In your place. So that you don't have to carry it anymore. She could have stopped. The curse would have waited. But for every name in that book, there was a person who deserved to live without pain. And she would carry it for them. She had survived ten thousand wounds in one day. And the curse was still writing. Still adding names. And she had made her choice: she would carry them all.
audio.bg_music: Horrific emotional Chinese orchestral, pain transference theme, blood sacrifice, ten thousand wounds, suffering carried 65 BPM
